results.title: Fuga
results.overview: Life has not been fulfilling to Mari.

results.title: CALL OF THE JAB
results.overview: A powerful cultural documentary about a Caribbean father and son who return to Grenada to reclaim ancestral stories. Blending folklore, myth, and underwater visuals, the film preserves Black heritage and reframes the feared Jab Jab as a symbol of resistance and identity.

results.title: The Potentials
results.overview: Teruichi Tsuchiya, 42, is a perpetual assistant to a master manga artist. He feels uneasy about his junior colleague who has debuted as a manga artist, his estranged wife who is a popular voice actress, and for some reason, he is constantly at odds with his daughter, who lives with him and is preparing for her high school entrance exams. Just as a 17-year-old manga series comes to an end, a new manga project comes along. Joining him are Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old editor who is aware of his lack of passion for his work, and Potato Yamada, a headstrong 40-year-old rookie assistant. What future awaits him after taking this step…?

results.title: Stiletto: A New Musical
results.overview: Set in 18th-century Italy, Stiletto follows Marco, a young castrato singer navigating the opulent yet perilous world of Venetian opera. His life changes when he meets Gioia; confident, strong willed...and supremely talented. But despite her musical gifts, as a black woman in a racist and misogynist society, there’s no chance for her to fulfil her dreams.  Marco recognises her talent and, sensing that they are both outsiders as well as sharing a love for music, they fall in love. When a murder shatters their world, Marco must confront his past to save her. A sweeping tale of ambition, love, sacrifice, and resilience, Stiletto brings an opulent, rarely explored slice of musical history to the stage.

results.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners II
results.overview: Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found.

results.title: Thank You For Coming
results.overview: Going behind the back of his manager, pop star NayLay agrees to do a live interview on morning radio, convinced it will promote his new album. But the interview takes an unexpected turn once rumors about NayLay begin to surface on air.

results.title: Little Signs
results.overview: Josh is preparing to release his late father's ashes into the sea at his dad's favourite spot, Old Hunstanton Beach. But during the night some strange things happen that can't be explained. Could this be Josh's late fathers' attempts to make contact?

results.title: Pining for Douglas
results.overview: When an overworked social media manager returns home for Christmas, she finds herself torn between saving her hometown's beloved 150-year-old Douglas Fir and a budding romance with the son of the tech giant's CEO who plans to chop it down.

results.title: MEMO
results.overview: Over the course of one night, in a single motel room, two filmmakers discover a startling rumor about their lead actor hours before their film premieres a prestigious festival.

results.title: Setannya Cuan
results.overview: People in a small village try to get rich by winning the lottery. Short on luck, they attempt to enlist the help of evil spirits by stealing their tombstones, and only offering to return them for the correct lottery numbers. But playing with the dead comes with consequences - which throw the village into chaos.

results.title: Okay
results.overview: Struggling with the loss of her husband, a widow processes her grief by searching for him amidst the cosmos.

results.title: Mr. Wonderful
results.overview: Three generations of men—a millennial on the run from a drug dealer; his father, a jaded professor trying to keep his job; and the family patriarch fighting senility—all struggle to find meaning in life.

results.title: People You May Know @ Sónar 2025
results.overview: Spanish duo Ylia & Phran are known for their raw energy and sparkling synths. People You May Know's sets are a cross between electro, rave and dub. A firm favourite with clubs and festivals, they are appearing this year at Sónar to present their new album Megafauna.

results.title: Tribute to David Bowie - Heroes Never Die
results.overview: The Molotovs kick things off in style with “Rebel Rebel,” followed by magical covers of “Heroes” (The Horrors), ‘Fascination’ (La Roux), “Let's Dance” (Jeanne Added), “Rock'n'Roll Suicide” (The Libertines), “Sound and Vision” (Anna Calvi), “Starman” (The Divine Comedy), and “The Man Who Sold the World” (Yasmine Hamdan): eight intense reinterpretations of David Bowie's work, delivered during an arty and decidedly London-esque stroll, which, from stage to studio, recreates the fragile intensity of a live performance.

results.title: Mimi The Mime
results.overview: A homeless mime and a struggling clown fight over the attention of a crowd on a NYC sidewalk.  When their fight draws more attention and money than their performances ever could, they  realize they struck gold. Broke, desperate and out of options, the pair transform their slapstick  routines into an underground bare-knuckle sensation called ‘Mime vs Clown’.

results.overview: Go behind the scenes of the wildest era in motocross
